reference_rule: Recompute unchanged-policy logprobs for the actual execution partition once before five epochs; do not use a different batch partition as an exact native likelihood reference.
required_before_scientific_training: Qualify actual rollout/actor likelihood partition and declared critic value/GAE protocol; systems synthetic returns do not qualify this.
Measure combined retained simulator, rollout model and actor footprint; actor-only headroom is not a full-iteration guarantee.
Use same measured native controller/accounting, bounded I/O and independent recovery in both training and eval.
capacity_scope: Largest safe tested native execution divisor of the fixed global2048 grid, without activation checkpointing; not an absolute hardware ceiling or simulator capacity.
